newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two north Japan credit associations say to merge.
newsitem.headline: Two north Japan credit associations say to merge.

text.p: Two regional credit associations based in Aomori Prefecture in northern Japan said on Tuesday that they plan to merge.
The merger of the two associations, Aomori Shinkin Bank and Tsugaru Shinyo Kinko, will be on an equal basis, officials at the two companies said.
Credit associations, or shinkin banks, are locally based small financial institutions which take deposits and lend mainly to members and are supervised by the Ministry of Finance.
The companies will announce further details on the merger at 3 p.m. (0600 GMT) on Tuesday, the officials said.
